comment: Release conditions for every exact-pinned version in package.json (dependencies, devDependencies and overrides),
plus any override added to clear an npm audit advisory. An exact pin is invisible to update-npm-deps.ps1 - that
script upgrades caret ranges and skips exact versions - so nothing would ever remind you a pin is stale. This file
is what makes that check happen: on every run the script executes each `check` and compares its trimmed stdout to
`expect`. Equal means the pin is still required; different means the condition that justified the pin has changed
and the pin should be re-examined. `check: null` means no mechanical test exists - it is reported for manual review
on every run instead of going quiet. Every exact pin must have an entry here, and every entry must name a package
that is actually present in the declared section; the script reports either mismatch.

satteri.why: The docs-site mdast plugins import their types from satteri, and the runtime that calls them is the satteri @astrojs/markdown-satteri (and Starlight through @astrojs/mdx) depends on, which is ^0.10.5. A newer satteri here type-checks the plugins against an API the docs build never runs, so the dev copy stays on the release Astro uses, and the peer range stays ^0.10.5.
satteri.manualCheck: When the newest @astrojs/markdown-satteri moves to a newer satteri, move this pin, the satteri peer range and @astrojs/markdown-satteri together, and re-run the docs build.

fflate.why: Clears GHSA-px8p-9vwx-vf98 (fflate unzipSync infinite loop on a malformed ZIP64 archive, >=0.7.0 <0.7.5). Reached only through satori, whose newest release pins fflate at the exact 0.7.3, so no bump reaches the fix. 0.7.5 is the patch release on the same minor. NEVER take the `npm audit fix --force` remedy: it downgrades satori to 0.32.0.
fflate.manualCheck: The check reads the exact fflate pin of the newest satori. When it reads 0.7.5 or later, drop the override and this entry, and re-run `npm audit`.

katex.why: Clears GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7 (KaTeX trust restrictions bypassed through existing prototype pollution, >=0.11.0 <0.18.2). Reached only through markdownlint -> micromark-extension-math, which declares katex ^0.16.0, so no bump reaches the fix. micromark-extension-math imports katex only in its HTML renderer, which markdownlint never calls (it uses the parser alone), so the forced minor cannot change a lint result. NEVER take the `npm audit fix --force` remedy: it downgrades markdownlint to 0.36.1.
katex.manualCheck: The check reads the katex range of the newest micromark-extension-math. When it admits 0.18.2 or later, drop the override and this entry once markdownlint's tree resolves to that release, and re-run `npm audit`.

js-yaml.why: Starlight declares js-yaml ^4 and loads it through a default import, which js-yaml 5 (ESM-only, no default export) does not provide, so the tree must stay on 4.x. 4.3.1 and below sit inside GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh; 4.3.2 is the patched release on the v4-legacy dist-tag. The override also holds markdownlint-cli2 below the js-yaml 5 it exact-pins for itself, which works because it only uses the named `load` export, which js-yaml 4 has. The check tracks the v4-legacy dist-tag, because a backport there is the only way an advisory leaves this tree while Starlight is on 4.x.
js-yaml.manualCheck: A newer v4-legacy publish means read its changelog and move this pin onto it. The override can go once nothing needs js-yaml 4, i.e. when `node -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('node_modules/@astrojs/starlight/package.json','utf8')).dependencies['js-yaml'])"` stops reporting ^4.x. Verify either change with `npm run docs:build` and `npm run lint:md`.

re2js.why: Clears GHSA-gg6h-894w-4m9c (RE2JS quadratic-time denial of service in lookbehind matching, >=2.2.0 <2.8.7). Reached only through markdownlint, whose newest release 0.42.0 pins re2js at the exact 2.8.6, and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 pins that markdownlint exactly in turn, so no bump reaches the fix. 2.9.1 is the version markdownlint itself moved to upstream, so the forced minor is the one it is tested against. An override reaches only this repository's own tree, never a consumer's, so every consumer carries the same override until the release below. NEVER take the `npm audit fix --force` remedy: it downgrades markdownlint.
re2js.manualCheck: The check reads the exact re2js pin of the installed markdownlint, which moves only when a markdownlint-cli2 release pins a newer markdownlint. When it reads 2.8.7 or later, drop the override and this entry, raise the markdownlint and markdownlint-cli2 floors in dependencies to those releases so consumers can drop their own overrides, and re-run `npm audit`.

typescript.why: TypeScript 7 (tsgo) breaks this toolchain: @typescript-eslint's parser crashes on the native API, so type-aware ESLint cannot run on 7. @typescript-eslint peer-requires the range below, so 6.x is the last usable major. Propagates to the whole tree via overrides.typescript = $typescript.
